ns2:course.label: Urban Ecology
ns2:course.description: Examines cities as natural systems, combining ecological analyses with historical, anthropological, and sociological studies of urban nature. Addresses ecological sustainability, growth management, biodiversity, ecology of parks, zoos and aquariums, environmental justice. Required field trip. Same as ENVS 406. 4 undergraduate hours. 4 graduate hours. Prerequisite: Senior standing or consent of instructor.
